body: Founder: 'TYLER lore expansion teaser as a blog post'. Covers the two newest Series X interludes: 'The Long Quiet' (an intentionally plotless infrastructure-drama episode that turns the real emily-agent 2-day OOM incident into an in-universe Emily OS silence, resolving into a 'log first, understand second' discipline rather than an explanation) and 'Recruitment Drive' (a RED GARDEN in-game cutscene dramatizing docs/BACKSTORY.md's nine-hero gang-formation lore, tying the 112-entry Multiverse Hero Compendium directly into the shipped MOBA roster). Published at https://okemily.com/blog/tyler-series-x-the-long-quiet-and-recruitment-drive/.
title: Blog post: TYLER Series X teaser (The Long Quiet / Recruitment Drive)
